The '''''Tellstar'''''<ref name="BMF 60" /> was an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Navy|navy]]. After the destruction of Lothal's [[Imperial Communications Center]], the ''Tellstar'' was used to capture and relay information from surface [[R4 courier droid|courier droids]] brought aboard.<ref name="RR" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Tellstar'' was named by [[Tim Veekhoven]] as part of the lore he introduced while writing the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon|''Build the Millennium Falcon'']] magazine.<ref name="SM">Social media correspondence with [[Tim Veekhoven]] {{C|[[:File:TimVeekhoven-Credits.pdf|screenshot]]}}</ref>
